description:
The unsigned calldata to lend `usdg` USDG: `txs` = USDG approve (when the allowance is short) then the vault's ERC-4626
        deposit(usdg, account), with the share preview, the APY estimate and the cap / gate / balance checks as {error, reason}
        (cap_exceeded, insufficient_balance, paused, not_eligible). You send every tx with the account's own owner key (needs ETH for
        gas); this server holds no keys and sends nothing.
name: lend_deposit_quote
